_comment: Copy to skin-schema/skins/<name>.skin.json and delete the _comment keys. Every constraint below is enforced by `cargo run -p skin-schema --bin validate-skin`.
name: Your Skin
_palette_comment: Colours per role. `friendly` and `enemy` are indexed by within-team shade slot, so a 2v2 roster can tell partners apart — make the two shades visibly different but obviously the same team. Spectated teams reuse these. free_for_all is indexed by paint slot: 0 and 1 double as the spectated blue and red sides and carry the same hue obligation; 2 and 3 are free.
_head_comment: core_ratio is 0.05..0.5 of a cell. core_color must stay dark: the roster paints a white ready-check on it, and players find the head by its core. The gradient brightens the body behind the head so a glance tells you which way a snake is travelling.
_outline_comment: extra_px is total across both sides (0..4). boost_band is pinned for documents — an opponent has to be able to see you boosting.
_labels_comment: Optional. Omit both and the renderer derives the label ink by contrast and uses the fill as the swatch, which is right for most skins. Set them only if you need a specific ink.
_animation_comment: Optional. Tracks modulate scalars only — body_lightness, outline_lightness, gradient_opacity. amplitude is 0..0.35 and period_ms is 120..60000; anything larger changes what colour the snake reads as rather than making it shimmer. Every step of the cycle is validated, so a skin cannot look fine at rest and go unreadable mid-pulse.
_base_comment: Optional arena dressing, attributed to the VIEWER — your base theme is how your game looks; opponents do not see it. Colours only: the renderer keeps zone geometry, wall thickness, text layout, and decides which side is friendly.
_celebration_comment: Optional goal dressing, attributed to the SCORER — everyone watching sees it, so this is the surface worth showing off. `effect` names a first-party renderer (currently only goal-impact-wave); a document picks which effect plays and what colour it is, never what code runs.
